user.description: More settings are available under Configure afterwards.

data_description.fan: Recorded and, if enabled below, switched while venting.
data_description.position_sensor: Only needed if the cover does not report its position reliably. For HmIP-BROLL: channel 3 (LEVEL in %), un-ignore it in Homematic(IP) Local. Leave empty to use the cover's own position.
data_description.require_light: Off: open on humidity rise only, also in daylight.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Without a room sensor, absolute humidity for closing is calculated from this.
data_description.humidity_sensor: A fast-reacting sensor near the shower. It may saturate (100 %).
data_description.room_humidity_sensor: E.g. the wall thermostat. If set, room humidity and temperature decide closing, stall detection and second venting; opening and shower end still come from the shower sensor. You can also pick the thermostat (climate) directly, its attribute “current_humidity” is then used.
data_description.room_temperature_sensor: Leave empty to use the current temperature of the thermostat (heating).
data_description.fan_control: Turns the fan on when opening and off when closing. If it was already running (e.g. via light or CCU), the integration leaves it alone.

core.description: Which entities control and measure the hatch.

venting.title: Opening and closing

data.shower_detect: Count a shower from a rise of (analysis)
data.close_offset: Close at baseline humidity plus (without temperature sensor)
data.max_open: Venting after shower end at most
data.close_ah_offset: Close at baseline absolute humidity plus
data.shower_end_drop: Shower end when humidity drops from peak by
data.stall_delta: Stalled if humidity drops less than
data.vent_until_dry: Vent down to the close limit if outdoor air is drier

venting.description: When to open and when to close.

data_description.rise_threshold: Rise of relative humidity within 5 minutes. The old blueprint used 8.
data_description.shower_detect: From this rise on, the analysis counts a shower even if the hatch does not open. Choose lower than the opening threshold.
data_description.close_offset: Only used if no temperature sensor is set.
data_description.close_abs: Fixed threshold (the old blueprint used 65 %). 0 disables it.
data_description.manual_duration: A manual opening is only closed after this time, not because of low humidity. If someone showers meanwhile, the automation takes over.
data_description.close_ah_offset: Closes once absolute humidity is back at the pre-shower value plus this amount. 1 g/m³ is roughly 5 % RH at 21 °C.
data_description.shower_end_drop: As long as humidity stays at its peak, the shower is assumed to be running and the hatch stays open.
data_description.hard_cap: Safety limit counted from opening, even if no shower end is detected.
data_description.max_open: Counted from the detected shower end. Before that the hatch stays open (up to the hard limit).
data_description.stall_enabled: Only after the shower end. If humidity barely drops during the observation period, further venting is pointless (e.g. humid outdoor air).
data_description.stall_delta: Closes if relative humidity drops by less than this value during the observation period.
data_description.extend_while_drying: If the venting time is over but the air is still humid and humidity keeps falling, venting is extended in 5-minute steps, up to the hard limit or until drying stalls.
data_description.cold_protect: Ends automatic venting when the room gets too cold (room temperature or thermostat reading).
data_description.mold_factor: As in the HA mold indicator: (T inside − T outside) / (T wall − T outside), measured at the coldest spot (e.g. the hatch reveal) with an infrared thermometer. 1.3 is a rough starting value for insulated walls.
data_description.vent_prediction_sensor: E.g. the sensor of the HACS integration “Vent Optimization” (minutes). Only logged and compared with the actual duration.
data_description.vent_until_dry: If humidity stalls while the room is still above the close limit and outdoor air is at least 2 g/m³ drier, venting is extended instead of closed for stalling (walls and towels are usually still drying). Limited by the hard limit and cold protection. Needs room temperature and outdoor values.

data.brightsky: Use DWD measurements of the nearest station (Bright Sky)

data_description.wind_enabled: Closes the hatch when gusts exceed the threshold, also after manual opening and with automation off. Source: measured gusts from the DWD station (Bright Sky), otherwise the weather entity.
data_description.wind_gust: Guideline only, adjust to your hatch.
data_description.brightsky: Temperature, humidity, dew point, precipitation and gusts of the nearest DWD station via brightsky.dev (free third-party service). Sends your coordinates rounded to 2 decimals (about 1 km) every 10 min.
data_description.rain_sensor: E.g. a DWD precipitation sensor (now or next hour). Takes precedence over the DWD station.
data_description.rain_threshold: From this precipitation on, the hatch only opens to the restricted position.
data_description.restricted_conditions: Only used if neither a rain sensor nor DWD measurements are available. Blocked weather (hail, storm) always applies.

data_description.heating_restore: Previous value restores the setpoint from the moment of opening (the weekly schedule is kept).
data_description.heating_enabled: Only useful if the thermostat has NO window-open function of its own. Homematic IP thermostats with a linked window contact use their own window-open temperature and ignore this value. The integration detects this and stops interfering.

data.second_threshold: Only if humidity is still above

data.button_open: Open button on the device (event entity)
data.button_close: Close button on the device (event entity)

data_description.button_open: Short: end pause. Long: enable automation.
data_description.remote_open: Like the device button, additionally opens the hatch.
data_description.remote_close: Like the device button, additionally closes the hatch.

data.contact_grace: Delay before comparing contact and position

cover_not_closing.title: {name}: roof hatch does not close
cover_not_closing.description: After two close commands the hatch is still at {position} %. Please check the motor, the CCU and the radio link. This notice disappears once the position sensor reports 0 % again.

cover_not_opening.title: {name}: roof hatch does not open
cover_not_opening.description: The hatch did not move after an open command. Please check the motor, the CCU and the radio link. This notice disappears after the next successful opening.

humidity_sensor_missing.title: {name}: humidity sensor missing
humidity_sensor_missing.description: The humidity sensor `{entity}` has been unavailable for more than 5 minutes. Showers cannot be detected without it.

position_sensor_missing.title: {name}: hatch position unknown
position_sensor_missing.description: The position (`{entity}`) has been unavailable for more than 5 minutes. Automatic opening is blocked meanwhile. Check the connection and battery; for HmIP-BROLL also check that channel 3 LEVEL is still un-ignored.

heating_ineffective.title: {name}: thermostat ignores the venting temperature
heating_ineffective.description: While venting, the thermostat stayed at {setpoint} °C instead of {vent} °C, probably because of its own window-open function. Recommendation: disable heating control under Configure → Heating and frost.

brightsky_unavailable.title: {name}: DWD measurements unavailable
brightsky_unavailable.description: Bright Sky (brightsky.dev) has not returned data for over an hour ({reason}). The weather entity is used meanwhile.
